spec.goal: Help people discover effects worth keeping and reusing; improve through observed usefulness instead of declaring a final product state.

questions.question: What did a person come to achieve, and what would tell them it worked?
questions.source: User selected Discover and reuse on 2026-10-06

questions.question: Where does a promising result stop becoming something useful?
questions.answer: Current Studio can edit and save a generator but lacks side-by-side alternatives, exact kept takes, and reversible iteration.

questions.question: What must survive change so exploration stays trustworthy?
questions.answer: Original recipe, selected seed/time/camera, chosen layer appearance, saved generator identity and old replay data.
questions.source: Seeded reuse goal and existing replay architecture

questions.question: Who is poorly served by the current path, and what does their context require?
questions.answer: Touch and keyboard users, motion-sensitive people, newcomers and AI-assisted creators need legible choices, pause, portable results and a shared validated contract.

questions.question: Which evidence would overturn this proposal?
questions.answer: Low keep-to-reuse conversion, unsuccessful replays, inaccessible controls, unwanted changes to kept layers, or increased feed cost.

alternatives.assessment: More novelty but leaves selection and reuse bottleneck unchanged.

alternatives.option: Replace the editor with a broad 3D engine
alternatives.assessment: High migration and performance risk before proof of user need.

alternatives.option: Make discovery, preservation and reuse one reversible loop
alternatives.assessment: Selected: builds directly on deterministic effects and solves the observed bottleneck.

decisions.value: bounded comparison, layer locks, undo/redo, exact portable takes and feedback review around the existing studio

additive v1 recipe and v1 take contracts; no rewrite of Funnel law or broad engine

spec.title: Effects Studio: discover, preserve, reuse, learn

futureReview.question: What evidence means value rather than attention?
futureReview.answer: Keep, reopen, export and publish are separate actual actions; an export is an intent signal, not proof of use in another project. No dwell-time optimization.

futureReview.question: How can future people and generators benefit without repeating the build?
futureReview.answer: Versioned take contract, same validator/renderer for human and AI, generator registration through existing library, frozen recipes and explicit compatibility rejection.

futureReview.question: What may change, and what must remain stable?
futureReview.answer: Extend comparison heuristics and editors additively; never silently migrate unknown versions or overwrite exact kept takes.

futureReview.question: How do we learn what we missed?
futureReview.answer: Optional open-ended usefulness/obstacle notes, bounded local action counts, inspectable exportable evidence, and a manual next-question review. No fabricated population evidence.

futureReview.question: What prevents success from becoming costly or excluding people?
futureReview.answer: Four static previews per comparison, no feed render loop changes, paused rendering on demand, reduced-motion default, visible keyboard controls, bounded metadata storage and transparent storage errors.

deliverables: Four deterministic sibling previews; locked layers remain geometrically identical at fixed seed/time.
Use variant reversibly with bounded undo/redo.
Keep exact take containing recipe, seed, time and camera; reopen/import/export it without mutating saved generators.
Save generator uses existing automatic Wonder Feed registry path.
Local Value review shows observed actions, explicit notes and next open question; no claim of global adoption.
Fix controls advertised for path renderers; pause without idle repaint; reduced-motion initial pause.
Document capability limits, automatic generator registration and versioned extension process.
acceptance: Two ordered v44 Funnel passes preserve verbatim Page 0, carry open questions and future review, and produce verifiable kernel receipts before implementation.
Fixed seed/time comparison preserves every locked layer's recipe and sampled geometry, original state and capacity limits.
Exact takes normalize, roundtrip and reject unknown versions, invalid time and corrupted payloads; storage caps and quota errors are explicit.
Selecting a comparison, undoing it and reopening a take work from the live Studio.
Saving a generator exposes its recipe to Wonder Feed; old recipe references remain unchanged.
No continuous preview RAF for comparison cards; no repeated painting while paused; touch and keyboard controls are available.
Existing Effects/Wonder/Pulse checks plus new deterministic workbench and sealed Funnel gates pass.

verificationRepair.problem: Pre-existing Whole Blueprint Hearth navigation script injected inside two generated HTML strings; failed release syntax check.
verificationRepair.change: Remove only the two invalid nested injections; preserve real top-level Hearth navigation and owner drafts.

obligations.evidence: Specified in the linked staged blueprint and acceptance criteria; implementation verification is separate.

references.query: Runs through the new funnel with the intention of getting the, like, the most amount of intelligence out of the funnel itself by asking it to produce the highest leverage blueprint for Sebastian's goals. But not about making the new product. It's about asking the correct open-ended, non-solution-assuming questions to build the next generation studio. And then build it. Oh no, actually make a— let's build it, yeah. Ooh, no, no, no. No, don't build it yet. Then take that blueprint and ask, How can I make sure that this continues to provide the most amount of value to as many people as possible to satisfy Sebastian's needs far into the future? Because there's not really an end state here. There's not really an end state. The end state is just everyone's happy and Sebastian is providing value to everybody. So that's really the end state. So, but how do I get as close as I can in this one move, in this one end-to-end blueprint of the next generation studio, and then build that blueprint?
